concerns.text: FR-001 says the dataset size must be "N samples (target N=1000)". The variable N is undefined, making the requirement ambiguous – it is unclear whether exactly 1000 samples are required or any size is acceptable as long as it is *targeted* at 1000. Clarify the exact cardinality requirement (e.g., "must contain exactly 1000 samples") to make the functional requirement verifiable.
